compiled_by: Agent J (from Agent F certification dependency order + Agent D EW gap distribution + governance-guard Rule 5 constraints)

design_principles: Governance-guard Rule 5: maximum 28 items per batch
Independent post-batch verification after each batch
Pack C and Pack D batches can run in parallel (different pack files)
CorrectChoice lock required before any EW authoring begins (see Pre-Flight §1)
EW authoring standard: minimum 50 chars, choice-specific, COSO-principled

wave_1.name: Foundation — COSO Framework + Control Environment + Risk Assessment
wave_1.rationale: These 4 items provide the conceptual scaffolding for all 34 remaining seeds. EC-008 (COSO framework) is the most foundational — all other Domain E items presuppose familiarity with COSO's five components. EC-060 (control environment/tone at top) and EC-061 (inherent vs control risk) are the first two COSO components. ED-042 (risk assessment likelihood/impact) is prerequisite for ERM items in Wave 2. Small batch (4 items) for quick certification pass and dependency unlocking.
wave_1.parallel_packs: EC-008, EC-060, EC-061 in Pack C + ED-042 in Pack D — parallel execution possible

wave_2.name: Core Concepts — ERM + Segregation of Duties + Limitations

sub_batch_2a.name: COSO ERM
sub_batch_2a.rationale: ERM extends the Risk Assessment foundation from Wave 1. Risk appetite and risk response strategies. ED-016 has 2 DL-013 boilerplate slots + 1 empty — needs full EW re-authoring.

sub_batch_2b.name: Segregation of Duties
sub_batch_2b.rationale: Highest CMA exam relevance of any Domain E sub-topic. EC-004 (design principles) should be certified before applied-scenario items. EC-066 is 3-HIGH-risk (only 1/4 EW slots populated). ED-075 has 2 DL-013 boilerplate slots.

sub_batch_2c.name: Internal Control Limitations
sub_batch_2c.rationale: Management override and cost-benefit limitation. Bridge the framework concepts (Wave 1) to practical application (Wave 3).

wave_2.parallel_packs: Pack C (EC-031, EC-004, EC-021, EC-066, EC-041) and Pack D (ED-016, ED-074, ED-075, ED-058) can run in parallel

wave_3.name: Control Activities — Core + IT-Dependent + IT Continuity
sub_batches_rationale: 3a (7 items): Core Control Activities — preventive/detective classification, physical controls, bank rec, compensating, independent verification, authorization, vendor master file. EC-025 (preventive vs detective) should lead this sub-batch since it provides the classification framework for remaining items. EC-020 is P0 priority (2 misaligned DL-010 slots + 1 empty — full re-authoring).

3b (6 items): IT-Dependent Control Activities — duplicate payment, IT access deprovisioning, application input validation, ITGC access, least privilege, authentication. Depends on preventive/detective distinction from 3a. EC-022 is 3-HIGH-risk (only 1/4 EW slots populated). ED-051 has DL-010 + DL-013 issues.
3c (3 items): IT Continuity and Change Management — backup/DR, change management (standard + emergency bypass). Depends on IT-dependent controls in 3b.
wave_3.parallel_packs: Pack C items (EC-025, EC-020, EC-028, EC-052, EC-022, EC-023, EC-024, EC-040) and Pack D items (ED-014, ED-025, ED-064, ED-010, ED-051, ED-035, ED-036, ED-071) can run in parallel

wave_4.name: Capstone — Fraud + Monitoring + I&C + Ethics + Governance

sub_batch_4a.name: Fraud Prevention
sub_batch_4a.rationale: Fraud triangle theory + applied purchasing fraud scenario. EC-014 is 3-HIGH-risk (only 1/4 EW slots populated). Depends on risk assessment (Wave 1) and limitations (Wave 2). EC-014 (fraud triangle) should precede ED-072 (applied scenario).

sub_batch_4b.name: Monitoring + I&C
sub_batch_4b.rationale: Monitoring (ongoing evaluations, exception reports, remediation) + Information & Communication (whistleblower). Depends on control activities foundation (Wave 3). EC-049 is the sole I&C seed.

sub_batch_4c.name: Ethics + Governance
sub_batch_4c.rationale: Code of conduct (ethics) + three lines of defense + audit committee oversight. Capstone items integrating all prior waves. ED-046 has 2 empty slots + 1 truncated boilerplate. ED-001 and ED-066 need DL-031 difficulty recalibration (labeled Difficult, actual Understand).

effort_estimates.estimated_session_hours: 8–12 (assuming 30-45 min per batch with independent verification)
effort_estimates.parallel_execution_time: 4–6 hours (Pack C and Pack D batches run concurrently where possible)

execution_rules: Independent post-batch verification required after each batch
CorrectChoice must not change — this is distractor authoring, not answer-key modification
CC audit must complete (Pre-Flight §1) before Wave 1 begins
Governance guard Rule 2 compliance verified for all CorrectChoice slots after each batch
Pre-delivery safety check after Wave 4 before any certification decisions

notes: Batch plan deduplicated from Agent F's 13-wave certification ordering into 4 execution waves with 7 sub-batches. All batches comply with governance-guard Rule 5 (<=28 items). Pack C and Pack D are on separate files — batches can run in parallel within each wave. The 9 DL-013 boilerplate slots (all in Pack D Items ED-016, ED-036, ED-046, ED-051, ED-075) should be replaced during their respective wave execution rather than as a separate boilerplate-specific pass.
